why: Batalha 1 da USA, a 3ª volta, A/B: o mesmo plano sem a referência.

chunks.text:
[Build]
{a snare roll crescendo and rising strings, a cymbal swell into a key change}

[Climax]
{everything returns one whole step higher: brass in unison on the motif, guitars and drums at full power}

[Climax 2]
{the trumpets harmonize the motif in thirds, a new countermelody in the strings, double-time snare}
